fusions.name: Rattling Line
fusions.desc: Snaps the tip into the first enemy it meets, which deals 4 damage, then carries on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 50% of that.

fusions.name: Hauled Tight
fusions.desc: Hooks an enemy up to 6 tiles away, which deals 12 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full reach, and stuns it for 1 second. The lash then carries on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of that.

fusions.name: Taut Between Two Posts
fusions.desc: Strings the lash 6 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Each Hit a Shackle
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 5. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: you deal 7% more damage per stack (33% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
